identity.name: Bounded Code Repair
identity.description: Repair one reproducible defect with a minimal change and behavioral evidence.

tools.purpose: Inspect scoped source, tests, and configuration.
Apply the smallest project-local repair after design approval.
Execute declared regression and behavior tests.

nodes.purpose: Reproduce the reported defect and capture the failing behavior.

loop.gather: Read only the report, relevant entry point, and current tests.
loop.act: Run the smallest command that reproduces the defect.
loop.verify: Require a stable failing assertion or behavior trace.

nodes.purpose: Implement the smallest change that addresses the reproduced cause.

loop.gather: Use the failure signature and only directly related source files.
loop.act: Apply one minimal repair and add or strengthen a regression test.
loop.verify: Run the regression test and relevant existing test subset.

nodes.purpose: Check behavior, scope, and regression risk without producer reasoning.

loop.gather: Read the defect, diff, and test output but not hidden reasoning.
loop.act: Inspect the changed behavior and probe one exception path.
loop.verify: Require passing regression evidence and no blocking finding.

criteria.outcome: The original defect is reproducible before the repair and absent after it.
criteria.verifier: Regression test executed against before/after behavior.
criteria.evidence: Test command, exit status, and captured failing/passing assertion.

criteria.outcome: Relevant existing tests and one exception path pass.
criteria.verifier: Scoped behavior test suite and independent review.
criteria.evidence: Test log and review result envelope.
